title: The apparent board
blurb: Why unclaimed cards are invisible threats, and why a bluffed check still counts.

steps.say: Check and checkmate are judged on the apparent board: claims count as if true. An unclaimed card threatens nothing yet. Move your king to e2, right in line with the card on e5.
He claimed Rook and now you're in check! A bluffed check is a real check until someone calls it. Do you believe him? Call!
steps.hint: Press Call in the bar under the board.
steps.success: It was a bishop pretending to be a rook. Claiming early gives a piece power, but it also gives you something to call.
